name: SEO Audit
description: Audit a target URL: extract keywords, scan competitors, draft prioritized action items.

stages.name: Fetch & extract
stages.prompt: Fetch the supplied URL. Extract title, meta description, H1-H3, and primary keywords. Return as JSON.

stages.name: Competitor scan
stages.prompt: Identify the top 5 ranking competitors for the primary keyword from the previous stage. Summarise what each does better.

stages.name: Action items
stages.prompt: Produce a prioritized list of SEO action items (P0/P1/P2) the page needs to close the gap.
